title: The bathroom maze hub.
content: Let’s talk about it. Please visit r/thatbathroommazedream. Do these exist in your mall world? For me they only exist in the mall, school, and airport and nowhere else. For me, the bathroom is always a gross disaster. The vibe is often industrial, maybe even steampunk. There are showers like in a gym locker room. It’s filthy, dimly lit, scary. The sinks are broken and spray water everywhere. The toilets are clogged, there are dirty diapers, used menstrual products, syringes, etc. It is always really stressful in there. There’s a feeling of urgency, embarrassment, a want for privacy. The toilets are often wonky and in strange places like hot tubs and showers. Nothing seems to work properly. The doors are nonexistent or broken. All genders are in there. Do you have a “hub” like this in your dreams? What similarities do you share?
